videos.why: The only ready Short: a phone's chip is in frame 0, the first line names Bell Labs and the second asks what the first transistor looked like, and the payoff holds the biggest sourced figure (up to 76B transistors in one Ada Lovelace chip).
strengths: The channel's core subject (chips), told as an invention story
Built part by part in 3D: gold foil, razor slit, spring, germanium
Payoff dives from one switch into a GPU die, then loops to the phone
risks: The bulb in the switch beat is not clearly recognisable
